questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Due to _________ 'eve teasing', parents conclude that it is not worth the danger of sending their daughters to school.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Due to _________ 'eve teasing', parents conclude that it is not worth the danger of sending their daughters to school.
questions.solution: Widespread' will be used because it means "extensively prevalent." The sentence implies that due to the extensive prevalence of 'eve teasing,' parents find it risky to send their daughters to school, making 'widespread' the correct option. Whereas: 'Rectified' means to correct a problem, which does not fit the context. 'Localised' means confined to a specific area, but the sentence emphasizes the prevalence, not restriction. 'Narrow' means limited or restricted, which is not appropriate in this context.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A) The monthly average price of the Indian basket of crude began to increase after Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022. B) It peaked at $116/bbl in June 2022. C) By May 2023, the price crashed to $75. D) But India’s retail fuel prices have remained frozen – no changes since May 22, 2022.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A) The monthly average price of the Indian basket of crude began to increase after Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022.
B) It peaked at $116/bbl in June 2022.
C) By May 2023, the price crashed to $75.
D) But India’s retail fuel prices have remained frozen – no changes since May 22, 2022.
questions.solution: A: "The monthly average price of the Indian basket of crude began to increase after Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022." This sentence serves as a good starting point, providing the background and context for the subsequent events

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The detail given by the instructor was the ______ one.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The detail given by the instructor was the ______ one.
questions.solution: 'Most updated' is correct because it is a superlative adjective that means the most recent or latest. The sentence refers to a specific detail provided by the instructor, which is described as the most current or up-to-date information. Superlative forms like "most updated" are used when comparing one thing against all others, which fits here since "the detail" is singular and specific. updating – "Updating" is a present participle, which means the process of updating. It cannot act as an adjective to describe "the detail" in this context. "Updates" is a plural noun, but the sentence refers to a singular "detail," making it grammatically incorrect.

The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Japan’s prime minister, Shinzo Abe, urged G20 leaders to / work together to defuse trade / and political tensions, describing it as / threats to global economic growth and stability.

options.text: Japan’s prime minister, Shinzo Abe, urged G20 leaders to
options.html: Japan’s prime minister, Shinzo Abe, urged G20 leaders to
work together to defuse trade

options.text: and political tensions, describing it as
options.html: and political tensions, describing it as

questions.solution: • 'describing them as' will be used instead of 'describing it as' because here 'it' is being used for 'trade and political tensions' (plural), which is incorrect. For plural noun, we will use 'them'; Like— The teacher gave the students their books and asked them to read.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A) So, as our MPs get ready to work from a swanky new office, they and, even more, their party leaders must ask what use is India’s new House for India if it can’t house thoughtful, civil debates and pass well-scrutinised laws that make things better for citizens. B) If the splendour and hi-tech amenities reflected new ambitions, the war of tweets and statements pointed to a bitter political divide that can act as a drag on that ambition. C) A grand ceremony and sharp political rhetoric greeted the new Parliament. D) Which is to say it would be tragic were the ways of the old Parliament carry over to the new one.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A) So, as our MPs get ready to work from a swanky new office, they and, even more, their party leaders must ask what use is India’s new House for India if it can’t house thoughtful, civil debates and pass well-scrutinised laws that make things better for citizens.
B) If the splendour and hi-tech amenities reflected new ambitions, the war of tweets and statements pointed to a bitter political divide that can act as a drag on that ambition.
C) A grand ceremony and sharp political rhetoric greeted the new Parliament.
D) Which is to say it would be tragic were the ways of the old Parliament carry over to the new one.
questions.solution: C: "A grand ceremony and sharp political rhetoric greeted the new Parliament."

questions.question: Comprehension : In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank. George Patton Jr said, “I don’t measure man’s success by how high he climbs, but how high he bounces back _____1_____ he hits the bottom.” Emotional and physical _____2______ often _____3______ us. Stages of life are soaked with such experiences. As a child, we were frustrated ____4______not getting things that we wanted dearly. In youth we may have been bullied and rejected. And so the story goes on in our working and home lives, as we grow older. _______5_____, each time, we manage to recover, after a few gaps of silent suffering. During these gaps we intentionally or unintentionally, disconnect and withdraw ourselves from outward happenings, silently submitting and somehow connecting with something deeper and mysterious that overtakes us, and finally gathering the strength to bounce back. This mysterious power is what drove us to rise above all challenges and carry on with life to the best of our abilities. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
